review.summary: Fix for symbolic save_idxs skipping index translation when all state variables are selected, causing ArgumentError/TypeError at runtime. The commit modifies production code in src/solutions/save_idxs.jl and adds/updates tests.
review.evidence: Issue #1460 clearly documents the bug: when save_idxs names all state variables, SavedSubsystem returns nothing, and the guard misinterprets that as 'no translation needed', leaking raw Symbol/Num into integer indexing paths. The fix translates symbolic save_idxs to integer state indexes in the saved_subsystem === nothing branch. The commit touches one production file (src/solutions/save_idxs.jl) and two test files, consistent with a targeted bug fix. The issue includes a clear reproduction scenario showing ArgumentError for all-variable symbolic save_idxs.

review.suggested_tests: 1. Test save_idxs with all state variables as symbols (e.g., [:x, :y, :z]) and verify integer indices are returned. 2. Test permuted all-variable save_idxs ([:z, :y, :x]) and verify correct reordering. 3. Test subset save_idxs still work correctly. 4. Test non-symbolic save_idxs (integers, Colon) pass through untouched. 5. Test that observed variables in save_idxs produce a clear error.
